description:
Add JUnit 5 tests to the Calculator project in Eclipse IDE. The project files are at ~/eclipse-workspace/calculator/.

The Calculator class in src/main/java/com/example/calculator/ has methods: add(), subtract(), multiply(), divide(), power(), and factorial(). The divide() method throws ArithmeticException for division by zero.

Your task:
1. Import the Maven project from ~/eclipse-workspace/calculator/ into Eclipse
2. Create a test class named 'CalculatorTest.java' in src/test/java/com/example/calculator/
3. Write JUnit 5 tests that verify the add(), subtract(), multiply(), and divide() methods work correctly
4. Include at least one test for the division-by-zero edge case using assertThrows(ArithmeticException.class, ...)
5. Run the tests via Eclipse (Run As > JUnit Test) and ensure all pass

Note: The test class must be at: src/test/java/com/example/calculator/CalculatorTest.java
